title: Analysis code for: Culture-proven neonatal infection: a graded association with total bilirubin and an erythrocyte signature confined to definite pathogens
description:
Analysis code (61 scripts: 54 Python and 7 R, plus the plotting-input CSV files) reproducing every number, table and figure reported in the manuscript. The code covers two neonatal clinical cohorts (MIMIC-IV v1.0 and MIMIC-III v1.4), the measurement-level phototherapy-mediation analysis, the within-subject 48 h/72 h replication of the paired culture-anchored design in MIMIC-IV, and human hepatocyte transcriptomes from GEO. Mendelian randomisation and colocalisation scripts from earlier versions are retained for audit but are not reported in this version.

No patient-level data are redistributed. MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV are access-controlled on PhysioNet and require credentialed access together with acceptance of the data use agreement; the clinical scripts expect a local PostgreSQL instance holding the MIMIC schemas. All other inputs (GEO) are public.

See 00_Code_Index_and_Run_Order.md for the script-by-script index, the recommended run order, runtime pitfalls, and a table mapping each manuscript number to its source script. The development repository is at https://github.com/ruijin1/IL6_HEPICIDIN.
